title: Big Larry
description:
BIG LARRY is a single player survival/thriller horror game, packed with immersive content! Play as a deliquent high school student meeting up with their best friend Ricky, for whats meant to be a fun night at Creek High.. Unfortunately, this gets you trapped inside with something dangerous… Look out for clues, pick up items, solve puzzles, and hide in lockers! Survive the night at Creek High and find an exit all while Big Larry is close behind!Creek HighCreek High has become a nightmare of a school ever since the school mascot BIG LARRY was found dead. The kids say its a myth but your about to put that myth to a test when you and your friend meet up at Creek High during one dark foggy night..

Heart Pumping Content• Escape Creek High
• Solve Puzzles

Stay quiet.. stay alert and DO NOT DISTURB the angry school mascot!Contact InformationSupport:

description_short: The dark night starts with a simple task. Suddenly realizing youre trapped and alone... your fight or flight response kicks in. Especially when the creepy school mascot was just found DEAD. Figure out puzzles, watch your surroundings and most importantly do not disturb BIG LARRY.
